response.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating

assumptions.assumption: 'At least 20.99' is inclusive, so the filter is replacement_cost >= 20.99.
'Average per film of rental_rate divided by rental_duration' means the per-film quotient is computed first and then averaged within each rating, not the ratio of the two group averages.

Missing values are handled by AVG, which skips NULL length values. rental_rate and rental_duration are NOT NULL, so no quotient is NULL and no division by zero is possible (minimum rental_duration is 3). No ROUND is applied, so values stay unrounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of group averages: average rental_rate divided by average rental_duration within each rating, rather than the average of per-film quotients.
alternatives.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating
